title: Family update (ward -> family-gateway)
description: The ONLY shape of patient information that may leave the ward network. Pushed outbound by the family publisher to family-gateway (safety invariant 3) after the privacy filter and a nurse approval. This schema is an ALLOW-LIST: any field not listed is rejected (safety invariant 2). It must never carry vitals, NEWS2 or any score, drug names or doses, auto-generated reassurance, staff identities, locations or response times, or other patients' data. Free text exists only for nurse-written notes.

linkId.description: Opaque family-link id bound to one admission. Not the admissionId, bed or patient label.

kind.description: Allow-listed update types from the whitepaper (section 7.2).

text.description: Nurse-written or nurse-approved template text. Required for nurse_note. Never generated by the system.

approval.description: Proof that a nurse approved this update. Deliberately carries no staff identity (staff protection).
